name: PR Lifecycle Orchestration
description: Orchestrates the end-to-end pull request lifecycle from authoring and structured review comments through multi-agent debate, iterative reviewer loops, CI/review-bot monitoring, stale-PR reconciliation, branch takeover, and human-gated or autonomous merge delivery.

timeline.details: Set prerequisites via `gaia dev fuse`: autonomous-pr-delivery, merge-ready-pr-delivery, receiving-code-review, finishing-a-development-branch, pr-ci-monitoring, format-output, multi-agent-debate, pull-request-authoring, stale-pr-reconciliation.
